newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell electronics unit fuels EPS.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell electronics unit fuels EPS.

text.p: Rockwell Internationl Corp said its electronics business accounted for 71 percent of its total sales and 87 percent of its earnings for the firt quarter ended December 31.

The company reported earnings of $179 million, or $0.82 per share, compared with $192 million, or $0.89 per share, for the period. The earnings came on revenue of $2.6 billion compared with $2.4 billion.
Of these amounts, electronics brought in $1.85 billion in revenue, compared with $755 million a year ago.
The electronics business also brought in $271 million in earnings, compared with $232 million. The automotive business brought in $41 million compared with $38 million, the company said.

The company said that automation -- $1.06 billion compared with $980 million -- provided the bulk of the electronics revenue. The automation revenue comprised 12.4 percent of the company's total revenue for the quarter, compared with 11.3 percent a year earlier.

The company also said its avionics and communications business accounted for $374 million in revenue compared with $339 million a year ago. The company said improved cost performance in its defense avionics business and the benefit from last year's restructuring charge to exit several non- strategic product lines were behind the jump in revenue.
Rockwell officials were not immediately available.
